info.title: CalorieScan AI API
info.description: REST API for CalorieScan AI. Metric units everywhere; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. Authenticate with a Bearer access token.

get.description: Always 200 while the process is up. Does not touch dependencies.
Checks the database, Redis (when used) and object storage. Answers 503 if any check fails.
Generated from the same route definitions that validate requests, so it matches the implementation. Swagger UI is at /docs.

post.summary: Create an account (optionally with the whole onboarding payload)
post.description: When `onboarding` is present, the profile, nutrition goal, first weight log and commitment are stored in the same transaction as the account, so signing up after the funnel is a single call.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

INVALID_ID_TOKEN

post.description: Verifies the identity token server-side, then creates or links the user.

401.description: INVALID_ID_TOKEN

post.description: Verifies the identity token server-side, then creates or links the user.

401.description: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN or REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED

post.description: Returns a new access token and a new refresh token. The old refresh token stops working. Presenting an already-rotated token revokes the whole token family (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED).
Idempotent. Also unregister the FCM token with DELETE /me/devices/{token}.
Behind FEATURE_PASSWORD_RESET. Always answers 202, whether or not the email has an account.

post.summary: Choose a new password with a reset token
post.description: Behind FEATURE_PASSWORD_RESET. Signs the user out of every device.

get.summary: Selectable values for every onboarding screen
get.description: Codes with English display labels for sex, workouts per week, referral sources, diets, goals and accomplishments, plus supported locales and the edit limits for the plan screen. The client localises labels by code.

post.summary: Calculate a nutrition plan without saving anything
post.description: Stateless. Powers the "great potential" chart, the "setting everything up" screen and the daily recommendation screen. Returns 422 GOAL_NOT_SUPPORTED when a "lose" goal is not advisable (BMI below 18.5), and 422 UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE below 13.

post.description: Same effect as the onboarding payload inside /auth/register, for users who signed up first. Idempotent: if the profile already exists, the stored state is returned unchanged.

put.description: Fields you omit keep their current value. Calories are clamped to 800-6000 and macros to their configured limits. Creates a new `user_edited` version; earlier days keep the goal that was active then.

post.summary: Upload a food photo for AI analysis

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

post.description: Used for both camera and gallery photos (`source`). The file type is checked by magic bytes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC; max 10 MB). The image is resized to 1280 px, stripped of EXIF and stored privately. The meal is created immediately with `status=queued`; poll GET /meals/{id} while it is `queued` or `analyzing`. A push notification is sent on completion. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo, up to 10 MB

post.summary: Log a packaged product by barcode

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

post.description: Looks the barcode up in Open Food Facts (cached) and creates a completed meal from the per-serving data. Answers 404 PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND so the client can fall back to manual entry.

post.summary: Manual entry, or a text description for an AI estimate

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

post.description: With `name`, `calories`, `proteinG`, `carbsG` and `fatG` the meal is created as completed (201). With only `description` an AI estimate is queued (202), exactly like a photo.

description.description: Queues an AI estimate instead of manual values

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

get.description: With `date` (YYYY-MM-DD, `today` or `yesterday`) returns that calendar day in the user's timezone, or in the `X-Timezone` header when sent. Paginate with `cursor`.

get.summary: Meal detail for the Nutrition screen

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

get.description: Includes signed image URLs (15 minute expiry), per-serving values, totals, health score and analysis progress.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

patch.description: Calories and macros are per serving; `quantity` (0.25 to 20) scales them and totals are computed on read. A meal that failed analysis becomes completed when all four nutrition values are supplied.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

delete.description: Soft delete. Deleted meals disappear from lists and daily totals.

post.summary: Fix Results: re-analyze with a correction

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

422.description: FIX_NOT_SUPPORTED (barcode and manual meals have nothing to re-analyze)

post.description: Saves the instruction (for example "that was chicken, not turkey, and no chips") and re-queues analysis with the original image plus every correction so far. The previous values stay in place until the new result completes.

get.summary: Home screen: calories and macros left for a day

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

get.description: Powers Today / Yesterday. `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `today` or `yesterday` (default today), resolved in the user's timezone, or the `X-Timezone` header when sent. Meals still analyzing are listed but not counted. `remaining` may be negative. The goal returned is the one active on that day.

get.summary: Calories vs goal, macro averages, streak and weight trend

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

get.description: The window ends today in the user's timezone (or the `X-Timezone` header). Each day is compared with the goal that was active on that day. The streak is capped by the window.
